edges.reason: transfer uses msg.sender as the source address of the forwarded transferFrom call.
transferFrom derives allowance ownership and caller identity from msg.sender.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] controlled by the caller.
delegate authorizes execution via require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend authorizes execution and debits balance via msg.sender.
constructor assigns owner and initial balance to msg.sender.
transfer unconditionally delegates to transferFrom.
ensure modifier gates entry into transferFrom.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf for _from and _to.
transferFrom subtracts from allowance when the caller is not the source.
transferFrom performs unchecked += and -= on balances mapped to the arithmetic unsafe operation.
approve directly assigns allowance without zero-first protection.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall after the owner check.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length and balance additions without overflow checks.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient.
ensure invokes pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure compares _from/_to against the owner state variable.
constructor sets owner to msg.sender.
constructor initializes totalSupply from the _supply argument.
constructor mints the entire supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the router address.
The UNI constant grants the router implicit privileged transfer rights in ensure.
_to parameter flows into transfer.
_value parameter flows into transfer.
transfer passes _value onward into transferFrom.
_from parameter is checked in ensure and used as balance source.
_to parameter is used as balance destination.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
_spender parameter keys the allowance mapping.
_value parameter is written into allowance.
parameter a is the delegatecall target.
parameter b is the delegatecall payload.
_tos parameter defines the batch recipients and loop bound.
_value parameter is the per-recipient amount.
_name parameter assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol parameter assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply parameter assigned to totalSupply.
_value is a multiplicand in the unchecked total computation.
_tos.length is a multiplicand in the unchecked total computation.
local total carries the unchecked product into the balance debit.
loop counter i drives the batchSend iteration.
loop-local _to is used for balance credit and event emission.
local UNI pair address is compared against _from in ensure.
pairFor returns the value assigned to the local UNI variable.
